title: Redesigning source control at Anthropic
summary: Anthropic engineers share their experience redesigning their internal source control system to better support their large-scale AI development workflows, addressing challenges with monorepo management, code review, and developer productivity at scale.
problem_solved: Scaling source control infrastructure to support large AI model development teams with complex dependency management and rapid iteration needs.
why_valuable: Provides rare insight into how leading AI companies handle engineering infrastructure challenges that are increasingly relevant as software teams grow in size and complexity.
